analysis.insight_summary: Forum users are experiencing problems installing and using [product_name] software on MacOS 12 Monterey. There is confusion and frustration, particularly due to outdated installation methods like DVDs and downloaded installers that fail to work with recent MacOS versions. Users expect more modern software delivery and straightforward cross-platform compatibility from [company_name], but they encounter obstacles using the software with MacOS.
